name: Cherry Servers
summary: Bare-metal and virtual server hosting in European data centres, billed by the hour or on fixed terms, with root access.
best_for: developers and small teams who want a single-tenant bare-metal or KVM server billed by the hour, with root access, in European data centres
skip_if: you want a managed host with support for your website software, you cannot do the identity check for card payments, or you need a fixed price list before you sign up
honest_knock: The exact price of each virtual-server configuration loads dynamically, so we could not read a full price list. Spot servers have no SLA and can be stopped on two minutes of notice, and card payments need an identity check.

pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-10 on cherryservers.com/pricing and /pricing/virtual-servers) Cherry Servers bills by the hour, the month or a longer fixed term, and the plan table shows prices excluding VAT. The overview page lists virtual servers from €0.015 an hour and dedicated servers from €0.084 an hour. The virtual-server FAQ says plans start at $3.5 a month for a 1 vCore Cloud VPS, and that every virtual plan includes 1 to 35 TB of traffic depending on the plan. Add-ons are priced separately: Elastic Block Storage from €0.066 per GB a month, Backup Storage from €2.99 for 50 GB a month (free for dedicated servers), a Floating IP from €2.00 a month, a 5-address public subnet from €16.00 a month and a load balancer from €10.14 a month. The site offers a 15-day money-back guarantee. Exact monthly prices for each virtual-server configuration load dynamically and were not visible in the page text, and the page quotes euros in one place and dollars in another, so check the plan table and the VAT line at checkout.
